entities.summary: Yevgeny Vitalyevich Balitsky is a Russian and former Ukrainian politician, entrepreneur, and former army officer who is currently serving as the governor of Zaporozhye Oblast, one of the Russian-occupied territories of Ukraine, since 2022.
